message: Goal: Create a Python project: 1) Create src directory 2) Write src/hello.py that prints Hello World 3) Write README.md 4) Run the script and verify it works

"README.md" "This is a Python project that prints Hello World." file-write "python src/hello.py" shell dup "stdout" get print "code" get 0 eq [ "Python script ran successfully" print ] [ "Error running the Python script" print ] if "Project setup and test complete" done
